planning.instructionalForm: Situation change/pairing/quantity model followed by own bounded written equation; optional numeric/operator tokens.
planning.scope: Finnish grades1–2, source-owned standalone support and low-stakes current-response checking. Canonical curriculum_refs copied as project provenance, not newly audited Finnish law/current curriculum claims.
planning.support: Adult reading optional, no spoken/naming/audio gate; free anchors to model/explanation/practice/exit and optional help/offline/extension.
planning.assumptions: Concrete objects/number words/numerals from actual prerequisite chain. Small +/- steps and equations explicitly explained where used; no new hard fluency gate.
planning.evidenceLimits: No timer, recall-speed, delayed retention, formal mastery, physical skill, efficacy, independent-credit or personal-history claims. Help/model/explanation and current feedback do not demonstrate independent construction/fluency.
planning.interpretation: FACT numeric answer checks a sum only; ARITH checks a written true quantity relationship with relevant parts, not just equal numeric totals; MENTAL requires two preserved parts plus correct result, accepts non-decade and commuted valid decompositions.
planning.uiSkill: game-studio:game-ui-frontend read and applied: calm tabletop math view, CSS theme variables, DOM controls, early action, low chrome, optional notes, meaningful manual state transitions, mobile wrapping.
planning.playtestSkill: game-studio:game-playtest read with shared checklist; planned source-preview boot/input/state/screenshot/lifecycle/resize checks320/390/1280, not integrated115 proof.
planning.animation: Finite manual steps/all/reset, no time loop or decorative character animation. No animation implies verified learner speed.

feedbackContract.rule: Input/change retire dependent current verdict. Explicit checks read every visible response/context field. Help-only and separate model edits preserve invariant practice verdict.

extensions.entryRevision: Own-body compact action/model adjacency after actual115 fullshell inspection; optional model selectors moved below figure. No shared chrome or mathematical/checker/module change. Author native recheck and different-author review required on this exact new revision.

Numerical truth remains distinct from role membership; unsupported kind/incoherent set fail closed.
